owner: CC — CC gates writes to this intention; the PostgreSQL service is the box's, installed by Akien's one elevated command and kept by Recovery (outline 6.3.5, 11.3.5).
intention: Every Windows cairn box runs PostgreSQL as an automatic Windows service bound to loopback only on 127.0.0.1:5433, never 5432, with a LOGIN CREATEDB role for the OS user, a pgpass in db_domain's instance space (~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass, port 5433) and a cairn database. That database is this box's caching backup copy of the one master db on akiendelllinux, and only the box's local db proxy writes it. 127.0.0.1:5432 is the proxy's address, and everything on the box talks only to the proxy (outline 11.3.5, 11.3.7).
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akienyoga9i: scratch_bus.launch('codemother') raised 'ConnectionError: no bus process answered at ...\bus.sock within 15s (spawned: detached; last answer: FileNotFoundError ... bus.port)'. The spawned bus died first, in ~/.cairn/logs/bus.log: BusDevice.scratch -> store.scratch -> connect -> ensure_database -> 'psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "127.0.0.1", port 5432 failed: Connection refused (0x0000274D/10061)'. yoga has no PostgreSQL at all: nothing on 5432, no postgresql service, no db_domain instance dir. So the /sorted door, which asks CodeMother over the bus since 17d570c10390, cannot cast from yoga, and every Windows builder needs akienasus to cast for it. Outline 11.3.5 says PostgreSQL is a host service installed and upgraded by Recovery, and 11.3.5.1 that every box keeps its own database; Recovery carried no PostgreSQL recipe on any platform (grep of cairn/devices/recovery: zero hits). AND POSTGRES ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH (measured 2026-11-14 on akiendell, which has the service and a green verify): scratch_bus.launch('codemother') on main then fails one step later at ensure_database with 'fe_sendauth: no password supplied' because the scratch HOME has no pgpass; the passfile fix 4b1c65ef9 (origin/passfile-d95796cdfb9b, tickets d95796cdfb9b/6c3f73bde8fd) cherry-picked on main brought the scratch bus up in 4.3 s and a scratch-HOME /sorted packet routed_forward. So a Windows box casts with this seam applied PLUS 4b1c65ef9; a box that already has PostgreSQL needs only the commit. CORRECTED 2026-11-17: the recipe used to put Postgres itself on 5432, mirroring akiendell. Akien, 2026-11-15 on akienlivingroom: "you don't talk to the db from here. you talk to the db proxy. that's why it's attached to that address." and "there is one master db, on akiendelllinux. every other db in the swarm is a caching backup copy. so the one here will be written by the dbproxy (and should be set up that way)". Every Windows box is a non-home box, so on this platform Postgres never binds 5432. CONSEQUENCE, measured 2026-11-17 on akienlivingroom: store.connect() dials 127.0.0.1:5432 hard-coded (cairn/devices/db_domain/tools/client/store.py:66), and no db proxy device exists yet. Until one does, a box set up by this recipe has no db path for the bus, the /sorted door or db proofs.
traces_to: outline 11.3.5 and 11.3.5.1 (PostgreSQL is a host service installed by Recovery; each box keeps its own database), 6.3.5 (the installer walks host-seams), Law 3 (verify measures before anything is called up), Law 7 (verify names the first missing piece)
cost: One UAC prompt for Akien (the EDB installer elevates itself). ~300 MB under C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17 and a data dir. A service running as NETWORK SERVICE, listening on loopback by default. Two generated passwords live only in pgpass; pg_install.options holds the superuser one until step 5 deletes it.

apply.note: Complete recipe, written to option (B): a Windows service, because 11.3.5 makes PostgreSQL a host service that Recovery installs and upgrades (winget upgrade carries it), not a portable copy. Steps 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 run as the user with no elevation; step 2 is the ONE command Akien runs, and its only elevation is the installer's own UAC prompt. No secret is ever on a command line: step 1 generates both passwords into files, the installer reads the superuser one from --optionfile, step 3 passes the role's as a bound parameter. Each step is idempotent. Ports corrected 2026-11-17: Postgres on loopback 5433, because 5432 is the local db proxy's. Used to mirror akiendell, measured 2026-11-14: postgresql-x64-17 Running/Automatic, pgpass present.
apply.1_secrets:
CC, unprivileged. Writes ~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass (lines 127.0.0.1:5433:*:postgres:<generated> and 127.0.0.1:5433:*:<USERNAME>:<generated>; kept if already present) and pg_install.options (superpassword, serverport=5433, disable-components=stackbuilder):
"$HOME/.cairn/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -I - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, secrets
d = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cairn" / "devices" / "db_domain" / "0"
d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p = d / "pgpass"
if not p.is_file():
    s, r = secrets.token_urlsafe(24), secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    p.write_text(f"127.0.0.1:5433:*:postgres:{s}\n127.0.0.1:5433:*:{os.environ['USERNAME']}:{r}\n")
s = next(l.split(":", 4)[4] for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.split(":")[3] == "postgres")
(d / "pg_install.options").write_text(f"superpassword={s}\nserverport=5433\ndisable-components=stackbuilder\n")
print("pgpass and pg_install.options written under", d)
PY
apply.2_install:
AKIEN, the one elevated step, typed at the CC prompt (bash) and approved at UAC:
! winget install --id PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL.17 -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --override "--mode unattended --unattendedmodeui none --optionfile $(cygpath -w ~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pg_install.options)"
Then CC, elevated or as Akien: set listen_addresses = 'localhost' in <data dir>/postgresql.conf (the EDB default is '*'), confirm port = 5433, and Restart-Service postgresql-x64-<n>. Measured 2026-11-17: the EDB installer listens on 0.0.0.0 and :: by default.
apply.3_role:
CC, unprivileged. As postgres over TCP with the pgpass, CREATE (or ALTER) ROLE <USERNAME> LOGIN CREATEDB with the generated password, bound as a parameter. libpq's default user on Windows is the OS user, which is what store.connect() sends:
"$HOME/.cairn/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -I - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, psycopg2
from psycopg2 import sql
p = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cairn" / "devices" / "db_domain" / "0" / "pgpass"
me = os.environ["USERNAME"]
pw = next(l.split(":", 4)[4] for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.split(":")[3] == me)
c = psycopg2.connect(host="127.0.0.1", port=5433, dbname="postgres", user="postgres", passfile=str(p))
c.autocommit = True
cur = c.cursor()
cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = %s", (me,))
verb = "ALTER" if cur.fetchone() else "CREATE"
cur.execute(sql.SQL(verb + " ROLE {} LOGIN CREATEDB PASSWORD %s").format(sql.Identifier(me)), (pw,))
print(verb, "ROLE", me, "LOGIN CREATEDB")
c.close()
PY
apply.4_database:
CC, unprivileged. As postgres over 127.0.0.1:5433 with the pgpass, CREATE DATABASE cairn OWNER <USERNAME> if it is absent. The schema and its rows belong to the local db proxy, which fills this cache copy from the home db, so this step creates an empty database and nothing else. Never use store.connect() here: it dials 5432, the proxy's address.
"$HOME/.cairn/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -I - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, psycopg2
from psycopg2 import sql
p = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cairn" / "devices" / "db_domain" / "0" / "pgpass"
me = os.environ["USERNAME"]
c = psycopg2.connect(host="127.0.0.1", port=5433, dbname="postgres", user="postgres", passfile=str(p))
c.autocommit = True
cur = c.cursor()
cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'cairn'")
if not cur.fetchone():
    cur.execute(sql.SQL("CREATE DATABASE cairn OWNER {}").format(sql.Identifier(me)))
print("cairn database present, owner", me)
c.close()
PY
